newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks end softer on Wall Street fall.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks end softer on Wall Street fall.

text.p: Taiwan's share index punched briefly through 9,000 points but failed to sustain the momentum, falling slightly at the close on Tuesday as Wall Street's plunge inspired local profit-takers, brokers said.
U.S. stocks tumbled on Monday after Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto set off waves of profit-taking with comments about potential sale of U.S. government securities by Japan.
Taiwan's index on Tuesday opened at an intra-day high of 9,014.48 points but ended at 8,918.17, a scant loss of 6.95 points or 0.08 percent.
